proposals.evidence: CDIAL 14024 hasta explicitly gives Maiya hā and Ky. hā̃ with oblique hātha, alongside nearby hath/hatth forms. Both alternatives in Maiya hā / hatʰ hand belong to the documented family. The slash and aspiration notation remain unchanged; this does not assert that the survey pair is specifically a direct/oblique paradigm. Local transmission is unresolved. Exact response: hā / hatʰ.
